results.title: budgetExposure(): per bar, the sessions split into full / partial / none / not recorded, with sets logged and checklist items ticked kept as separate units
The bars themselves are unchanged: budgetData() still counts every completed session once per category it belongs to, whatever its completion
Budget page: a full and a partial Strength session are told apart under the bar; the line reports logged sets and flags earlier sessions as not recorded; no combined total is shown
Units are never mixed: checklist sessions report checklist items, lifting sessions report sets, and neither is converted into the other
Coach Handoff carries the same logged-exposure lines (sessions with their completion split, and the unit-specific work logged); no bar means no line
Classification unchanged: Giant C stays Capability, the six ambiguous templates stay unclassified and are still disclosed as not counted; they never get a logged-exposure line
Only completed sessions from the last 7 days count; drafts and old sessions are excluded from bars and from exposure alike
Reporting is read-only and does not alter any record
